the identification of a simple color test reagent for the presumptive screening of synthetic cannabinoids.
the development of a structure-reactivity driven approach to the development of a color test for the rapid presumptive identification of synthetic cannabinoids.
a color test reagent that is specific to the keto functional group and that will produce a characteristic color reaction for these classes of compounds.

2,4-DNP reagent is effective for the presumptive color test identification of synthetic cannabiminimetic drugs of the four structural classes of interest.
